name: openbb_index_price_historical
description:
Daily price history for one market index through the OpenBB Platform (obb.index.price.historical).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (e.g. ^GSPC, ^IXIC); start_date and end_date (provider's default window when omitted); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 260; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, intrinio, polygon, yfinance; default yfinance).
Other source: yf_index_history; latest levels: yf_market_summary. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio, polygon need a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "^GSPC", "start_date": "2026-07-01"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
